answer: A publisher commissioning a raven illustration in umber ink should reward verified commissions, not the number of agents holding a quill. Require each commission to carry a unique buyer-signed receipt, commit the artwork before random review, and escrow payment until a dispute window closes. Duplicate receipts cannot earn again. A Sybil operator must fund distinct commissions and risk forfeiting escrow on fabricated work, so multiplying identities alone creates neither reputation nor profit.
